mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 68-degree partly cloudy skies at City Hall. The overnight low will be 66 degrees with rain expected. Also, catch the International Space Station tonight starting at 4:11 AM, moving from the northwest over Cross Plains toward the northeast near Madison.

Verona is currently working on an eighteen-month update to its Comprehensive Plan to guide city growth through 2026. A task force is currently overseeing the process, and residents are encouraged to visit the Envision Verona website to participate in public feedback opportunities.

There is plenty happening tomorrow, including the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Looking further ahead, the Verona Area Kids Triathlon takes place on August 30 at the high school.

In a report covering August 17 to August 24, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash on August 19 at North Main Street and Bering Drive, where two drivers were cited for various traffic violations following a collision that fortunately only resulted in minor injuries.
Culver's is currently closed for the evening. We hope you enjoyed the OREO Cookie Cheesecake today, and you can pick up a Chocolate Caramel Twist when they reopen tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
